page.title: MCP Server
page.subtitle: Public information for assistants: what Uha does, how Unlimited works, where to install it, and which currencies it supports.
page.config_body: Add the endpoint above to a client that supports remote MCP servers. Select Streamable HTTP if the client asks for a transport. No Uha account or API key is required.
page.compatibility_note: Setup steps and configuration formats vary by client. Follow your client’s remote MCP instructions. Opening the endpoint in a browser does not connect an assistant.
page.scope_body: This server returns public information about Uha. It cannot read your subscription data, access your iCloud backups, control the app, make payments, or cancel subscriptions.
page.tool_info: App overview, platform, features, and public product information.
page.tool_pricing: Free and Unlimited plan limits and how the one-time purchase works.
page.tool_links: Official website, App Store, and TestFlight links.
page.tool_currencies: Currency codes, symbols, and formatting metadata.
